decision: set a high-rigor installer hotfix predicate
why: archive extraction is a security and activation boundary, so success must include the pinned artifact and hostile links

decision: download and inspect the pinned Whisper 1.9.2 archive
why: the reported path must be reproduced from the exact bytes Echo installs before changing extraction

decision: treat archive member order as data, not a dependency contract
why: libwhisper.so appears before its symlink target libwhisper.so.1, and the final regular file appears later; the generator resolves the chain but runtime extraction requires each immediate target to exist already

decision: keep custom selected extraction and its explicit link boundary
why: Rust tar documentation supports safe path and link validation, while Echo additionally needs a closed subset and flattened destinations; Ref returned no indexed match, so official docs.rs and pinned local source were read directly

decision: choose complete graph validation before create-all and hash-all
why: it removes archive-order dependence with one pure helper while private staging and final verification keep transient links unobservable

decision: record G55 as a design dropout
why: the runner exceeded the bounded scope and was interrupted; its incomplete temporary artifact did not survive, so no claims or grafts are taken from it
